name: pharos-threshold-guardian
description: Pharos Agent Arena Task 7 - Threshold Guardian: evaluates multiple configurable on-chain conditions against real Atlantic Testnet state before deciding whether an action should FIRE or HOLD. Read-only; never signs or sends transactions.

scripts.guardian:fire: npm run -s build && node dist/src/index.js --config config/guardian.fire.json
scripts.guardian:hold: npm run -s build && node dist/src/index.js --config config/guardian.hold.json
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run scan:secrets && npm run audit:prod
